agyos_skill.intent: Curated architectural guide to zero-cost developer infrastructure. Covers free tiers for hosting, serverless Postgres, vector databases, authentication, object storage, and background queues.
agyos_skill.instructions: An architectural decision playbook for selecting and composing zero-cost developer infrastructure for early-stage software, MVPs, and production side-projects. Curated providers offering reliable free-tier allowances without requiring upfront credit card lock-in: - Cloudflare Pages / Workers: Unlimited static requests, 100k free worker invocations/day, global edge network. - Vercel: Free tier for personal Next.js and frontend projects with serverless API functions. - Fly.io / Railway / Render: Starter instances suitable for lightweight API services and background workers. - Neon Postgres: Serverless PostgreSQL with 0.5 GB storage, instant branching, and connection pooling. - Supabase: Managed Postgres with 500 MB database, built-in Auth, Row Level Security, and realtime websockets. - Cloudflare D1: Serverless SQLite with 5M reads/day and 100k writes/day. - Upstash Redis: Serverless Redis with 10k commands/day, ideal for rate-limiting and session caches. - Cloudflare R2: 10 GB free storage/month with 0 egress fees (S3-compatible API). - Supabase Storage: 1 GB free bucket storage for user uploads and media. - Clerk: Generous free tier for modern React/Next.js authentication and user management. - Supabase Auth: Complete email/password and OAuth provider integration out of the box. - Resend: 3,000 emails/month free for transactional authentication and notifications. - Postmark / SendGrid: 100 emails/day developer tier. - Upstash QStash: Serverless HTTP-based message queue and cron scheduler for async task dispatch. - Inngest: Event-driven background functions with automatic retries and step execution. - Pinecone: 1 free serverless index with 2GB storage for vector embeddings. - Algolia: 10,000 search requests/month free tier. - Cloudflare DNS: Free global authoritative DNS with DDoS mitigation and automatic TLS. - Semgrep: Free CLI and community rules for SAST scanning in GitHub Actions. - Sentry: Developer plan with 5,000 free error events/month for exception telemetry. - Axiom: Free tier for centralized JSON log ingestion and query analytics. - GitHub Actions: 2,000 free runner minutes/month for automated tests and build validation. - Frontend & Hosting: Vercel or Cloudflare Pages.
